schema_version.description: Schema version for this JSON file format. Phase 1 shot-chain model is schema version 2.

starting_debt.description: Starting debt in in-game dollars. Whole-number currency amount.

weekly_debt_interest.description: Weekly debt interest rate as a decimal fraction, not a percentage. Example: 0.10 means 10% per week.

catch_vig.description: Collector catch vig as a decimal fraction, not a percentage. Example: 0.30 means 30%.

bookmaker_overround.description: Bookmaker overround as a multiplier, not a percentage. Example: 1.10 means a 110% book.

min_offered_odds.description: Minimum decimal odds a market outcome may have to be offered. Handicap lines whose either side falls below this are not shown (a real book only offers sensible lines around the expected margin). Example: 1.10.

shot_base.description: League baseline shots per team per match.

on_target_base.description: Baseline probability that a shot is on target, as a decimal between 0 and 1.

conversion_base.description: Baseline probability that an on-target shot becomes a goal before keeper adjustment, as a decimal between 0 and 1.

corner_base.description: League baseline corners per team per match.

assist_rate.description: Baseline probability that a goal has a named assister, as a decimal between 0 and 1.

second_half_factor.description: Relative second-half attacking intensity multiplier versus the first half.

home_advantage.description: Home-team attacking multiplier applied inside atk_eff. Example: 1.08 means an 8% boost.

formation_mods.description: Per-formation flat modifier package for attack, defense, shots, corners, and passing.

factor_tier_magnitudes.description: Standardized factor effect magnitudes m used in (1 ± m).

max_factors_per_match.description: Maximum number of active hidden factors in a single match.

factor_count_weights.description: Probability mass function over 0..max_factors_per_match active factors.

factor_rarity.description: Relative without-replacement selection weights for hidden factors.

pricing_sim_count.description: Monte-Carlo simulation count used to price public odds.

correct_score_cap.description: Maximum enumerated goals per side before Any Other Score absorbs the residual.

over_under_lines.description: Goal totals lines offered for Over/Under markets.

handicap_lines.description: Supported Asian handicap half and whole lines only.

validation_fixture_count.description: Number of fixtures in the validation harness.

edge_threshold.description: Minimum expected-value edge required before the informed bettor places a 1-unit stake.

blind_roi.description: Derived blind betting ROI target. For a 1.10 book, this is 1/1.10 - 1 = -0.0909.

blind_roi_band.description: Inclusive lower and upper ROI bounds for the blind bettor gate.

even_money_odds_range.description: Inclusive decimal-odds window for the even-money subset win-rate report.

informed_win_rate_min.description: Lower bound for the even-money informed win-rate subset.

informed_win_rate_max.description: Upper bound for the even-money informed win-rate subset.

min_even_money_bets.description: Minimum qualifying even-money bets before the win-rate gate becomes binding.
